annotations.title: Show a model and its prices

description: Show one MakeViral Create model: the shapes, sizes and lengths it makes, the photos, clips and sounds it takes, special inputs (end frame, multi-shot, elements, motion style), and the price in credits for every size and length. With resolution, durationSec and count it also gives the exact price of that choice, so you can tell the user before create_image or create_video.

clipSeconds.description: Optional, seconds of a reference clip (they add to the price)

referencePhotos.description: Optional, video reference photos (one model charges for more than 5)

resolution.description: Optional, to price one choice: e.g. '2K' (image) or '720p' (video)
